## Summary

Describe the maintainer problem and resulting behavior.

## Scope

- [ ] The PR links a related issue or explains why no issue is needed.
- [ ] The change is intentionally scoped and reviewable.
- [ ] User-facing CLI, JSON, docs, or process changes are called out.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests cover success, failure, and boundary cases.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_quality.py` passes locally.
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes locally.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the behavior.
- [ ] Security impact was considered and sensitive details are not public.
- [ ] Release notes or `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when user-visible behavior changes.
